signature: SUBROUTINE DSYTRS_3( UPLO, N, NRHS, A, LDA, E, IPIV, B, LDB,

params.name: uplo
N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrix B. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference:
Diagonal of the block diagonal matrix D and factors U or L as computed by DSYTRF\_RK and DSYTRF\_BK:

-   a) ONLY diagonal elements of the symmetric block diagonal matrix D on the diagonal of A, i.e. $D(k,k) = A(k,k)$; (superdiagonal (or subdiagonal) elements of D should be provided on entry in array E), and
-   b) If `UPLO = 'U'`: factor U in the superdiagonal part of A. If `UPLO = 'L'`: factor L in the subdiagonal part of A.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: e
params.reference:
On entry, contains the superdiagonal (or subdiagonal) elements of the symmetric block diagonal matrix D with 1-by-1 or 2-by-2 diagonal blocks, where If `UPLO = 'U'`: $E(i) = D(i-1,i)$,$i=2$:N, `E(1)` not referenced; If `UPLO = 'L'`: $E(i) = D(i+1,i)$,$i=1$:N-1, `E(N)` not referenced.

NOTE: For 1-by-1 diagonal block D(k), where $1 \le k \le N$, the element `E(k)` is not referenced in both `UPLO = 'U'` or `UPLO = 'L'` cases.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: Details of the interchanges and the block structure of D as determined by DSYTRF\_RK or DSYTRF\_BK.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the right hand side matrix B. On exit, the solution matrix X.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
